root_cause.mechanism: The bounded satisfied-row reconciliation changed pending/retry or expired-running queue rows to complete after observing existing creator_funders output, but emitted no COMPLETED lifecycle event and no telemetry-gap record.

repair.boundary: The worker now captures the exact satisfied-row cohort before its authoritative update, commits the queue transition, then appends one idempotent COMPLETED event per row. A failed telemetry append retains fail-open queue correctness and writes durable gap evidence through record_event_fail_open.
repair.terminal_contract: Every active Creator Funding worker terminal mutation must produce a terminal ledger event or durable telemetry-gap evidence. Queue state remains authoritative.
repair.duplicate_safety: Lifecycle event identity includes obligation, transition, timestamp, attempt, provenance and correlation; identical retries are INSERT OR IGNORE.

writer_census.legacy_listener_writer: Present but disabled by LISTENER_CREATOR_FUNDING_QUEUE_ENABLED=0; it is not an active production consumer and was not restarted.

qualification_snapshot_contract.consistency: A short SQLite read snapshot captures actionable queue state and event rowid high-water together. The snapshot record is appended afterward and describes that immutable read boundary.
qualification_snapshot_contract.event_boundary: Qualification reads lifecycle event rowids strictly greater than START high-water and less than or equal to END high-water.

next_step: Observe a new uninterrupted >=60 minute window beginning at the durable start snapshot, then capture END and run X78.40 against the two snapshot boundaries.
